description: ipld/blocks.rs raw_block() returns data.to_vec(), unconditionally copying the input slice. Both header_block() and body_block() pass their input bytes through raw_block(). Callers in builder.rs already own Vec<u8> values. Accepting Cow<[u8]> or a Vec<u8> by value (and returning it without copying) would eliminate the copy for the common case. This matters for large article bodies.
title: core: ipld/blocks.rs raw_block copies data bytes; callers already own the Vec
